settings.title: FAQs
settings.intro: Answers to the questions we hear most about raw hair, lace, installs, and maintenance.

settings.question: Is your hair 100% raw and unprocessed?
settings.answer: Yes. Our hair is single-donor, cuticle-aligned raw hair. It has not been chemically processed for color or texture — you get natural movement and longevity when cared for properly.

settings.question: How long will my extensions or wig last?
settings.answer: With consistent care, most clients enjoy 1–2+ years from bundles and 6–12+ months from a well-maintained lace unit. Lifespan depends on heat use, wash frequency, and install method.

settings.question: Can I color or bleach the hair?
settings.answer: Raw hair can be colored, but we recommend a professional stylist. Always strand-test first and deep condition after any chemical service. Bleaching will affect longevity — treat hair gently afterward.

settings.question: How often should I wash my install?
settings.answer: Every 7–14 days is typical. Wash sooner if you sweat heavily, use a lot of styling product, or notice buildup at the roots or lace line.

settings.question: What products do you recommend?
settings.answer: Use sulfate-free shampoo, a moisturizing conditioner, leave-in conditioner, and a light serum or oil on the ends. Avoid heavy products at the lace or weft area.

settings.question: Do you offer exchanges or returns?
settings.answer: Please review our store policies for current return and exchange terms. Unopened, unused items in original condition may qualify — contact support with your order number for help.

settings.question: How do I choose the right origin or texture?
settings.answer: Indian and Vietnamese hair tend to be silkier; Cambodian and Burmese offer more natural volume and texture. Use our Hair Quiz or reach out — we are happy to match you to your goals.
